caption: The drawing shows a single hair comb placed centrally against a plain, light beige background. The comb has a broad, rounded top that narrows as it transitions into six long, tapered teeth. The entire surface of the comb features a mottled brown, amber, and yellow pattern resembling tortoiseshell. The comb is depicted with subtle shading to create a sense of depth and three-dimensionality. No other objects or details are present in the drawing.
title: Comb
